Here is my first Ok looking pseudo based on Dave's upcoming process.

First exposure 1 minute

soak

Move angle 

Second exposure 1.5 minutes

only a 30/70% H2O and IPA

100% IPA all room temperature

blow dry.

The only thing I need to master is removing the excess liquid after soak. I don't have a lab sqeegy yet so used my gloved finger. Any suggestions?

posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md: Excellent progress, Tony! For a squeege, forget about photographic versions as they are waaay too hard. Go with the holographer's choice ... Anco windshield wiper blades. I recommend the largest type, cut to a convenient length and glued to a metal bar to keep it straight and get a handle on it.

posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md: Nice job Tony! After the soak in the swelling bath, lean the plate on a side wall and on top of a sponge, as the excess run off will be sucked up via the sponge, after about 20 mins move the plate to the drying box ..............
